svg.title: FROST cache hierarchy: coherent CPU path and line-cache component benches
svg.desc: Two views of the FROST cache library. Section 01 shows the coherent CPU cache hierarchy composed by frost_hart and frost_cluster_memory for the RV64GCBV X3 configuration: a 128 KiB four-way MSI L1D (coherence_l1d) with a read-hit pipeline, eight CPU read slots, four ordered combining store records, eight request endpoints (two supporting stream prefetch), cbo.zero and Zicbom CMO support, a two-active and six-victim fetch_provider feeding the 16 KiB four-way read-only L1I with two miss slots and one-cycle flash invalidation, a shared 2,048-entry four-way L2 TLB with a 32-entry superpage side array and Sv39 pointer-walk-cache PTW over two ReadOncePTW bridge slots, and an eight-ID coherent hart line client shared by the vector memory unit (six IDs) and the misaligned-access engine (two IDs). Coherent channels (D, C, G, U, P, R, W, WA) join the hart to frost_cluster_memory, where 4:1 D and C arbiters combine hart cache requests, eight-slot coherent DMA ingress (NIC, DMA test engine and Svpbmt uncached DDR alias), a coherent prefetch agent tracking four data and two instruction streams (three data and one instruction request in flight, paused during DMA), and the hart line client into the 2 MiB four-way UltraRAM L2 coherence home (64-byte lines, eight fills with two reserved for demand, two writeback slots). The home orders sectors, probes L1D, merges dirty replies, recalls victims and issues load-queue cuts, then feeds cpu_memory_fabric (which combines L2 lines with narrow uncached traffic on a 512-bit AXI4 master) and DDR4 at 0x80000000. Section 02 shows the line-cache component hierarchy (frost_hart_cache and frost_cluster_cache, composed by frost_cache_hierarchy) used by cache component benches: 128 KiB L1D with shared probe injection, a shared Sv39 walker coherence sequencer, a 16 KiB read-only L1I with two miss slots and flash invalidation, a three-lock DMA coherence sequencer, an optional four-stream L2 prefetcher, 2:1 and 3:1 starvation-bounded tagged arbiters, a 32-to-64-byte line-size adapter, shared 2 MiB UltraRAM L2, 512-bit line_port_axi_bridge and behavioral DDR model. Arrows follow requests and probes; most response and maintenance control paths are omitted.

svg.text: Coherent channels: D / C (demand / done), G / U (grant / release), P / R (probe / reply), W / WA (PutM / ack).
All three DDR caches are 4-way. Private L1D / L1I sectors are 32 B; shared L2 home lines are 64 B.
FROST_HART_CACHE · PRIVATE CACHES, WALKER SEQUENCER & PROBE INJECTION
3:1 priority · L1D > walker > L1I > DMA > prefetch (16-grant starvation bound)
L1I / L1D: 4-way, 32 B lines. L2: 4-way, 64 B lines. Responses route back by transaction ID prefix.
